caption: The drawing depicts a staircase with a handrail and balusters rendered in shades of brown and tan, suggesting a wooden construction. The handrail features rounded vertical balusters with spindle-like detailing, evenly spaced along the railing, which follows the incline of the stairs and extends horizontally at the base. The stair treads, risers, and stringer are visible, all shaded in a similar tan or light brown color. The staircase begins at the lower left and ascends towards the upper right of the image. Three supporting newel posts are shown: one at the base, one at the turn, and one at the top of the stairs, all with rounded tops. Shadows suggest the stairs are drawn with a light source coming from the upper left. The background is plain and light in color, with no additional elements except for the artist's name, "Lon Cronk," written twice in the lower right corner.
title: Shaker Stairway
